traceability.evidence:
Implementation and tests for Story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md are present and all related tests pass.
Key implementation files: - src/maintenance/detect.ts - Implements detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath: string): string[] - Uses getAllFiles (src/maintenance/utils.ts) to scan workspace. - Extracts @story paths via regex and uses isUnsafeStoryPath/enforceProjectBoundary from ../utils/storyReferenceUtils to enforce project boundaries and avoid unsafe paths. - Returns [] if workspace root does not exist or is not a directory. - Marks a story as stale when no in-project candidate files exist. - Fully annotated with @story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md and @req REQ-MAINT-DETECT.
- src/maintenance/update.ts - Implements updateAnnotationReferences(codebasePath, oldPath, newPath): number. - Verifies codebasePath exists and is a directory; returns 0 otherwise. - Uses getAllFiles to traverse all files, then replaces occurrences of '@story ' with '@story '. - Only writes back files whose content changed; counts and returns number of replacements. - Function and helper are annotated for REQ-MAINT-UPDATE.
- src/maintenance/batch.ts - batchUpdateAnnotations(codebasePath, mappings[{ oldPath, newPath }]): number. - Loops over mappings and sums updateAnnotationReferences results. - Satisfies REQ-MAINT-BATCH (batch updates) and reuses updateAnnotationReferences. - verifyAnnotations(codebasePath): boolean. - Calls detectStaleAnnotations and returns true iff no stale annotations remain. - Satisfies REQ-MAINT-VERIFY.
- src/maintenance/report.ts - generateMaintenanceReport(codebasePath): string. - Calls detectStaleAnnotations. - Returns empty string if no stale annotations; otherwise returns newline-separated list of stale @story paths. - Annotated for REQ-MAINT-REPORT and REQ-MAINT-SAFE.
- src/maintenance/utils.ts - getAllFiles(dir): string[] - Recursively traverses directories, validates dir exists and is a directory, and collects only regular files. - Shared utility underpinning detect and update functionality.
- src/maintenance/flags.ts - parseCliInput, normalizeCliArgs, parseFlags, ParsedFlags. - Implements predictable, minimal CLI parsing for --root, --json, --format, --from, --to, --dry-run. - Throws clear Error for invalid --format values (e.g., 'yaml'), enabling higher-level error handling. - Annotated under REQ-MAINT-SAFE.
- src/maintenance/commands.ts - EXITS: EXIT_OK = 0, EXIT_STALE = 1, EXIT_USAGE = 2. - handleDetect(normalized): - Uses parseFlags, detectStaleAnnotations, prints either JSON ({ root, stale }), 'No stale @story annotations found.', or a list of stale paths plus a summary line. - Returns EXIT_OK if no stale annotations, EXIT_STALE otherwise. - Satisfies REQ-MAINT-DETECT and REQ-MAINT-SAFE (well-defined exit codes). - handleVerify(normalized): - Uses verifyAnnotations; prints success or guidance message and returns EXIT_OK or EXIT_STALE. - Satisfies REQ-MAINT-VERIFY and REQ-MAINT-SAFE. - handleReport(normalized): - Uses generateMaintenanceReport, supports --format text|json. - For text: prints either 'No stale @story annotations found. Nothing to report.' or a human-readable markdown-like header and report body. - For json: prints JSON { root, report }. - Satisfies REQ-MAINT-REPORT and REQ-MAINT-SAFE. - handleUpdate(normalized): - Validates presence of --from and --to; on missing flags prints error and returns EXIT_USAGE (no modification). - If --dry-run: does not modify files; uses generateMaintenanceReport to estimate impact and prints either JSON or human-readable summary ('Dry run: no files were modified...'). - Otherwise, calls updateAnnotationReferences and prints JSON or human-readable summary of number of annotations updated. - Satisfies REQ-MAINT-UPDATE and REQ-MAINT-SAFE (explicit arguments, dry-run mode).
- src/maintenance/cli.ts - runMaintenanceCli(rawArgv: string[]): number - Uses normalizeCliArgs to determine subcommand and args. - If no subcommand / -h / --help: prints detailed help (printHelp) and returns EXIT_OK. - Switches on subcommand: detect/verify/report/update mapped to corresponding handlers. - For update: if handler returns EXIT_USAGE, prints help as well. - Catches any thrown error, formats as 'traceability-maint failed: ', prints to stderr, returns EXIT_USAGE. - printHelp() output describes all commands, options (including --root, --json, --format, --from, --to, --dry-run), and general usage. - Annotated to REQ-MAINT-DETECT/VERIFY/REPORT/UPDATE/BATCH/SAFE. - At module bottom: if require.main === module, invokes process.exit(runMaintenanceCli(process.argv)), integrating with the bin in package.json.
- src/maintenance/index.ts - Re-exports detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, generateMaintenanceReport as the public maintenance module API. - Annotated with all REQ-MAINT-* requirements.
Tests explicitly tied to this story (all passing in the Jest run): - tests/maintenance/detect.test.ts - @story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md - [REQ-MAINT-DETECT] returns [] when there are no files / no annotations. - [REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detects stale annotation references when a file references a non-existent story (stale.story.md).
- tests/maintenance/detect-isolated.test.ts - @story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md, @req REQ-MAINT-DETECT. - Validates: - Non-existent directory returns []. - Nested directories with two stale stories produce exactly two stale entries. - Permission denied scenario: detectStaleAnnotations throws; CLI layer then handles this (see cli.test.ts), demonstrating error propagation and handling. - Security behavior: malicious relative '../outside-project.story.md', absolute '/etc/passwd.story.md', and invalid-extension 'invalid.txt' are never passed to fs.existsSync, while normalized in-workspace paths (traversalInside, legitimate.story.md) are checked. Confirms security validation of story paths and no filesystem access outside the workspace.
- tests/maintenance/update-isolated.test.ts - @req REQ-MAINT-UPDATE. - Verifies: - Updating @story old.path.md to @story new.path.md in a temporary file returns count 1 and the file content contains '@story new.path.md'. - updateAnnotationReferences returns 0 when the directory does not exist.
- tests/maintenance/update.test.ts - @req REQ-MAINT-UPDATE. - Ensures when there are no matching annotations, updateAnnotationReferences returns 0 (no-op behavior).
- tests/maintenance/batch.test.ts - @req REQ-MAINT-BATCH and REQ-MAINT-VERIFY. - [REQ-MAINT-BATCH] batchUpdateAnnotations returns 0 when no mappings applied. - [REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] verifyAnnotations returns true when annotations are valid (uses a temporary dir with matching story and .story.md file).
- tests/maintenance/report.test.ts - @req REQ-MAINT-REPORT and REQ-MAINT-SAFE. - generateMaintenanceReport returns '' for a workspace with no stale annotations. - When a temp file has '@story non-existent.story.md', the generated report contains 'non-existent.story.md'.
- tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts - Comprehensive CLI behavior for Story 009.0: - [REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detect exits 0 and logs 'No stale @story annotations found.' when workspace has no stale annotations. - [REQ-MAINT-VERIFY] verify exits 0 and logs once when annotations are valid (matching .story.md file exists). - [REQ-MAINT-REPORT] report exits 0 and logs a human-readable summary including 'Traceability Maintenance Report' and the stale story. - [REQ-MAINT-UPDATE] update performs replacements (file content changes from old.path.md to new.path.md) and exits 0. - [REQ-MAINT-SAFE] update without --from/--to exits 2, logs error to stderr, and logs help text. - [REQ-MAINT-SAFE] dry-run mode exits 0 and does not modify the file content; logs a textual dry-run summary. - [REQ-MAINT-SAFE] report with invalid '--format yaml' exits 2, prints error including "Invalid format: yaml" and "Expected 'text' or 'json'". - [REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detect supports '--json' output: exits 1 when stale exists, logs a JSON payload with array `stale` containing 'stale.story.md'. - [REQ-MAINT-DETECT] detect with non-existent --root exits 0 and logs 'No stale @story annotations found.' (missing root handled gracefully). - [REQ-MAINT-SAFE] invoking CLI with no subcommand prints help and exits 0. - [REQ-MAINT-SAFE] a simulated EACCES from fs.statSync during detect causes runMaintenanceCli to exit 2, log an error containing 'traceability-maint failed:', and not crash.
- tests/maintenance/index.test.ts - Confirms that maintenance index exports all required functions: detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, generateMaintenanceReport, satisfying integration requirement and REQ-MAINT-SAFE (safe, centralized API surface).
Additional relevant tests affirming integration and behavior: - Root Jest run (npm test -- --verbose): - All maintenance-related suites passed: - tests/maintenance/report.test.ts - tests/maintenance/batch.test.ts - tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts - tests/maintenance/detect.test.ts - tests/maintenance/detect-isolated.test.ts - tests/maintenance/index.test.ts - tests/maintenance/update-isolated.test.ts - tests/maintenance/update.test.ts - Overall summary: 35 test suites passed, 266 tests passed, 0 failed.
Documentation and integration evidence: - README.md, 'Maintenance CLI' section (lines ~110–150): - Explains purpose: "The `traceability-maint` CLI helps you maintain and audit `@story` annotations outside of ESLint runs. It focuses on repository-wide checks for stale story references and safe batch updates." - Lists commands: detect, verify, report, update, with succinct descriptions of each. - Provides example usage for all commands: - `npx traceability-maint --help` - `npx traceability-maint detect --root .` - `npx traceability-maint verify --root .` - `npx traceability-maint report --root . --format json` - `npx traceability-maint update --root . --from "docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md" --to "..."` - Points to user-docs/api-reference.md#maintenance-api-and-cli for deeper API and CLI documentation. - package.json - "bin": { "traceability-maint": "lib/src/maintenance/cli.js" } - Ensures the compiled CLI is exposed as the `traceability-maint` binary when the package is installed. - This, combined with the process.exit(runMaintenanceCli(process.argv)) logic, integrates maintenance tools into the overall project tooling.
Taken together, the code, tests, and documentation demonstrate that all listed requirements (REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-UPDATE, REQ-MAINT-BATCH, REQ-MAINT-VERIFY, REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE) are implemented and behaviorally verified by automated tests, and that user-facing documentation and integration points are in place.
traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for Story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS are met: - Core Functionality: detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, and verifyAnnotations implement detection, updating, and verification of annotation references. Tests cover stale detection, isolated and nested directory scenarios, and updating annotations across files. - Quality Standards: Operations only modify @story comment values, not executable code. Updates are applied via targeted regex substitutions and only when content changes; tests confirm correct updates and no-op behavior when no matches or directories are missing. - Integration: Maintenance tools are part of src/maintenance, re-exported via src/maintenance/index.ts, and wired into the published binary via package.json. They reuse existing story validation utilities (storyReferenceUtils) and follow the project’s traceability annotation conventions. - User Experience: The CLI provides clear, contextual messages, including success messages, summaries, and guidance on follow-up commands. JSON output modes support machine consumption. Help text is comprehensive and displayed on explicit requests or usage errors. - Error Handling: Missing directories return empty results; invalid format flags produce clear error messages and non-zero exit codes; permission errors in detect are caught at the CLI layer and surfaced as prefixed diagnostics; update requires explicit --from/--to and offers safe dry-run mode. - Documentation: The README includes a dedicated Maintenance CLI section with command descriptions and concrete usage examples, and it points to a more detailed API & CLI reference. Tests for this story reference the story file explicitly and all pass under Jest, providing strong verification of behavior.
Therefore, the story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md is fully implemented and verified: status PASSED.
